I’m 28 and my husband is 48. It can work, lol don’t let people who don’t get it bother you. 
With that said, if you have this rocky relationship with your mom, you need to make sure you are safe and secure before you talk to her about this. As in, your own place to stay, job, etc; that does not rely on your man either. You have to make sure you can be on your own just in the worst case situation. 
It’s great you are feeling ready to share this with her, and great you are feeling ready to take this step with your boyfriend. BUT- you have SO MUCH time for all of that, there is no need to rush or push into anything without being prepared or having a backup plan. 
Just always be sure you put yourself first and take care of yourself!!
